summary: v69 tested end-to-end (backend + UI). Unified /login with next and role preselect, legacy login redirects, escrow keepIf, partner forgot/reset (API + UI), partner statements (partner/admin PDF, bad month 422, admin send/resend, cron auth and idempotency), badges, public highlights (codes vs names, homepage section hidden when empty), partner Leaderboard tab, and admin leaderboard/statement controls all PASS. Regression v67 (33) and v68 (11) PASS when run serially. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: When an email fails, the row is still upserted (email_ok=false), so later non-resend runs (cron on the 1st, or a retry) skip it. Failed sends are never retried automatically. Skip only rows with email_ok=true.
Sends to every approved partner, including those with zero activity that month. Confirm this is intended.
One partner can hold all 3 badges, so the homepage shows 3 cards for the same partner code (seen in UI). Consider merging badges per partner.

issues: With Partner selected, the email/password inputs and the Continue button are wider (~1393px right edge) than the role cards (~1355px), so the form looks misaligned.
statement-month and admin-statement-month use the browser's native <input type=month> instead of a shadcn-styled picker.
Badge chips in partner-badges have no gap between them.
reset-go-signin links to /login without ?role=<portal>. The auto-redirect does keep the role.

window.open is called after an await (blob fetch), so it is no longer a direct user gesture. Safari and iOS popup blockers may block it. Consider a download anchor, or opening the window first and then setting its location.
nextRole maps /partner paths to 'supplier'. Add /partner -> 'partner' so partner email deep links preselect Partner.

action_items: Optional: in send_statements, retry rows where email_ok=false (only skip when email_ok is true).
Optional: fix the partner-role form width on /login, add /partner to the nextRole mapping, add role to the reset-go-signin link, and make the PDF open popup-safe.
critical_code_review_comments: Cron endpoint: Bearer check uses hmac.compare_digest, acks 2xx and runs the work in the background. Correct.
Badges/highlights call _board and run one find_one per partner on every public request. Fine at the current scale; cache the result if the number of partners grows.

Do not run v67, v68 and v69 together under xdist (pytest.ini adds -n --dist loadscope). The modules share global state (commission settings, reg:* rate-limit cleanup, statement sends to all approved partners), so 6 v68 tests failed in a combined parallel run. All pass when each file runs with -n 0. Not a product bug.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test_partner_*/test_sup_* @example.com data was created and fully cleaned up: agents, registrations, vendors, commissions, partner_statements, cron_runs test-cron-*, reg:* attempts. The leaderboard setting was restored (absent). vendor_seq was reset to 0 and the partner_code counter removed, since no agents remain. The 3 orphan partner_statements rows left by the parallel run were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run v69 with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v69_partner_statements_login.py -n 0. For UI seeding: python tests/seed_v69_ui.py seed (prints RID; partner password PartnerPw@123), then python tests/seed_v69_ui.py clean <RID>. Partner tab testids: partner-tab-suppliers|wallet|leaderboard. Admin partner row: admin-agent-row-{id}. The browser tool may load page_url twice, which can consume one-time reset tokens; navigate with page.goto inside the script instead.
